title: SOA: Clear previous search filter
summary: The item search function now clears stale filters before processing a new search, preventing previous results from affecting subsequent searches.
key_points: Removes SystemId filter before each new item search
Prevents previous search results from restricting new searches
Ensures empty searches correctly reset the search state
Fixes search behavior in Sales Order Agent
quote: Clears the stale SystemId filter before processing a new item search.
